name: Joinery Messenger
description: WhatsApp-style messaging in the member area: conversations and groups with near-realtime delivery, read receipts, typing indicators, replies, reactions and attachments.
author: Joinery

settings.name: messenger_active
settings.label: Messenger enabled
settings.helptext: Turns the member Messages app on. With it off the app and its API actions refuse; existing conversations are untouched.

settings.name: messenger_default_protection_level
settings.label: Protection level for new conversations

options.standard: Standard - the server manages messages for you
options.private: Private - sealed at rest, readable only while a participant is present
options.guarded: Guarded - Private, plus no message content leaves in notifications

settings.helptext: What a new conversation starts at when the member does not choose. A conversation can be raised afterwards but never lowered.

settings.name: messenger_max_group_size
settings.label: Largest group
settings.helptext: How many people one group conversation may hold.

settings.name: messenger_max_attachment_mb
settings.label: Largest attachment (MB)
settings.helptext: Per file. The server's own upload limit still applies on top of this.

settings.name: messenger_poll_thread_seconds
settings.label: Open conversation (seconds)
settings.helptext: How often an open conversation asks for new messages. Lower feels more instant and costs more queries.

settings.name: messenger_poll_list_seconds
settings.label: Conversation list (seconds)
settings.helptext: How often the list refreshes when no conversation is open.
